_notes.use: One card per clip, filled from TEMPLATE.md steps 1-4. Replace every <placeholder>; write TO_MEASURE or OWNER_QUESTION with a reason instead of guessing.
_notes.decision_values: NONE | CINEMATIC | REUSE | CODE_FIX | VARIANT | GENERATE | KEYS_THEN_GENERATE
_notes.status_values: DRAFT | DECIDED | KEYS_READY | GENERATING | IN_REVIEW | ACCEPTED_TEST | ACCEPTED | REJECTED
_notes.locks: Generator-independent identity and continuity locks adapted from the V2 shot card; every required_prompt_phrase must appear in generation.prompt.
_notes.claims: ARCHIVE_COMPLETE, GENERATION_READY and DELIVERY_ACCEPTED stay separate; runtime integration and owner, device and child acceptance are separate again.
